pages.text: Tectonic and Terralith shape the terrain: real mountain ranges, deep valleys, long rivers. Biomes O' Plenty fills them. Distant Horizons shows the far side of the valley from your door.$(br2)Rivers and coasts matter: Valkyrien Skies ships (Eureka) and wagons from Caravans & Convoys are how goods move before rails exist.
The Nether is Incendium's: new biomes, new structures, and the Nether Reactor — which in this story is the machine that was stolen. The End is Nullscape. Both are late-game chapters.
